name: Chrome Web Store Reviews
title: Chrome Web Store Reviews Scraper
uses: Extension developers reading every review past the 500 review cap
Competitor research on low-star reviews to find what users want fixed
Tracking user count, rating and version changes for a list of extensions
AI agents summarizing complaints and feature requests for a Chrome extension

inputs.name: extensionIds
inputs.title: Extension IDs or Chrome Web Store URLs
inputs.description: One extension per line: a 32-character ID (e.g. cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm) or a chromewebstore.google.com / chrome.google.com/webstore URL.

inputs.name: maxReviewsPerExtension
inputs.title: Max reviews per extension
inputs.description: How many reviews to return per extension. 0 means all public reviews (paginated past 500). Default 200.

inputs.name: starFilter
inputs.title: Star filter
inputs.description: Optional list of star ratings to keep, e.g. [1, 2] for one- and two-star reviews only. Leave empty for all ratings.

inputs.name: phrases
inputs.title: Phrases to count in low-star reviews
inputs.description: Optional phrases. Adds one free keywordSummary row per extension with case-insensitive counts over reviews at or below Low-star max. Counts cover only the reviews returned in this run, not estimates.

inputs.name: lowStarMax
inputs.title: Low-star max (for phrase counts)
inputs.description: Phrase counts use reviews with this rating or lower. Ignored if Phrases is empty.

inputs.name: includeSummary
inputs.title: Add a free summary row per extension
inputs.description: Adds one uncharged row with the Store user count, average rating, rating count, current version, and the rating distribution of the reviews returned.

description: Scrape Chrome Web Store reviews past the 500-review cap. Give extension IDs and optional star filters; get rating, date, text, language, version and helpful votes, plus user count, average rating and current version. Free low-star phrase counts. No login or proxy. $0.0001/review.
